entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who, after the Brothers' War, vows to destroy Phyrexia and is aided by Xantcha.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian newt created as a sleeper agent who turns against Phyrexia and helps Urza; narrator of the novel.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon, Xantcha's overseer, who opens her mind and is destroyed by Urza's powerstones.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A slave resembling Mishra whom Xantcha finds to impersonate Urza's brother.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's dead brother, whose corruption obsesses Urza.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The white planeswalker creator of Serra's Realm, who helps Urza recover.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An artificial plane of the Phyrexians, who were Thran cast out from Dominaria.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The enemy that Urza vows to destroy, revealed to be rebel Thran cast out of Dominaria.

entities.name: Fourth of Nine Spheres
entities.description: The Phyrexian sphere where Xantcha was created and her heart kept.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Urza's home plane, once encased in a Shard.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A plane where Urza sees a vision of the ancient Thran fighting Phyrexians and later fights Gix.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Artificial white plane created by Serra where Urza recovers.

entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: A plane visited in Urza and Xantcha's search.

entities.name: Vatraquaz
entities.description: A plane visited in Urza and Xantcha's search.

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: An impenetrable shard encasing Dominaria and nearby planes, later broken.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient people who fought Phyrexians and from whom Phyrexians originated.

entities.name: Glimmer Moon
entities.description: A moon whose white-magic apex activates Urza's screaming spiders.

entities.name: Ohran Ridge
entities.description: Remote location where Xantcha and Urza live in a cottage.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War between Urza and Mishra, ended before the novel begins.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast that ended the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Five years after the Sylex Blast Urza returns to Dominaria, sees a vision on Koilos, learns the stolen powerstone was a keystone against Phyrexia, and swears vengeance.
events.quote: Urza swears vengeance on Phyrexia and vows to destroy it.

events.summary: Xantcha is created in the Fourth Sphere as a sleeper agent; Gix opens her mind; she sabotages missions and is saved from execution by Urza.
events.quote: Xantcha is created as a newt in the Fourth of Nine Spheres to be a sleeper agent sent to Dominaria.

events.summary: Urza enters Phyrexia with a dragon engine and destroys swaths of it; Xantcha recovers her heart and tells him to planeswalk away.
events.quote: Xantcha follows him and recovers her heart from the Fourth Sphere

events.summary: Pursued by Phyrexian negators, Urza and Xantcha flee across planes and land in Serra's Realm, where Serra helps Urza recover.
events.quote: There Urza recovers with the help of the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra.

events.summary: Xantcha gives Urza her heart to show loyalty; the Shard is broken and Urza brings Xantcha to Dominaria in 3210 AR.
events.quote: Eventually, the Shard is broken and Urza brings Xantcha to Dominaria in 3210 AR.

events.summary: Xantcha finds Ratepe to impersonate Mishra to shake Urza from his stupor; Urza plans to expose sleepers with spiders.
events.quote: Xantcha finds a man who physically resembles Mishra, a slave named Ratepe

events.summary: On Koilos Xantcha and Ratepe discover that the Phyrexians were Thran who rebelled and were cast out of Dominaria.
events.quote: The Phyrexians were actually Thran that rebelled and were then cast out from Dominaria.

events.summary: The Glimmer Moon activates the spiders, killing nearby sleepers, and Urza chases Gix to Koilos.
events.quote: The Moon activates the spiders and all the nearby sleepers are affected and killed.

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe free Urza's powerstones, which destroy Gix; both are lost in the explosion.
events.quote: Ratepe and Xantcha are lost in the explosion.

events.summary: Urza awakens, finds Xantcha and Ratepe gone, and resolves to go to the past, remembering he has Xantcha's heart.
events.quote: remembers Xantcha's heart and realizes that he will never be alone

relations.note: Gix is a Phyrexian demon and Xantcha's overseer

relations.quote: allows Xantcha to accompany him after she gives him her heart to show her loyalty
the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra
